title: GOOD: Admin config validate-at-parse-time, not at runtime
description: transit/config.rs calls check_admin_config() from inside Config::validate(), which is called from Config::from_file(). This means an insecure admin configuration (non-loopback without bearer_token) is a hard startup error, not a runtime surprise. The dual-layer design (validation at parse time in check_admin_config plus a runtime guard in start_admin_server) is belt-and-suspenders: the validation prevents the misconfiguration from ever reaching startup, and the runtime guard catches any code path that bypasses config loading. Tests explicitly cover all three combinations: non-loopback without flag (error), non-loopback with flag but no token (error), non-loopback with flag and token (ok). Error messages name the exact TOML keys to set, which is the right UX for a startup fail-fast.
